UL Ultra Light New Regular (U02UL) — round-neck crew T-shirt, Cotton 100% No.32, Sulfur Free (NOT a polo). No T-shirt SKU exists. New-SKU candidate.

completeness_note: All 10 supplied images are product spec sheets (PMK PoloMaker) covering: 4 jacket models, 2 round-neck T-shirt models, and 4 polo families. NO apron, NO work-shirt (เสื้อช็อป), NO work-trouser (กางเกงช่าง), and NO cap images were supplied — confirmed by re-opening all 10. Therefore 9 of 13 SKUs (EX047-EX055: 2 aprons, 3 work shirts, 1 trouser, 3 caps) have status no_image and need supplier photos. 4 SKUs match cleanly: EX042 jacket (primary Smooth bomber, 7 colours), EX044 CoolPlus CA polo (9 colours), EX045 CoolPlus CP polo (15 colours), EX046 plain polo (01KM, 11 colours). 6 models have no SKU: 3 extra jacket models (Smart/Baseball/Simply), 2 round-neck T-shirts (Ultra Zoft, UL), and the contrast-tipped 01PK/01PC polo family. Folder is named 'เสื้อ หมวก' (shirts + caps) but contains zero cap photos.
